name: Dewan Rakyat
notes: 222 seats; parties shown by coalition as the Dewan lists them (PH, BN, PN, GPS…); unfilled seats show as Vacant.

name: Dewan Negara
notes: 70 seats: 26 elected by the state assemblies (two each) and 44 appointed by the Yang di-Pertuan Agong. Who sits and their party are from the Dewan Negara's own list of members (parlimen.gov.my), 56 of whom were named on 28 October 2026; the other seats show as Vacant. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.
